final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day_of_above_average_ratings, AVG(r.avg_per_day - o.overall_avg) AS avg_excess FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.avg_per_day > o.overall_avg
